data.body:
[P2] Retain unresolved failures in the ambiguity check

If a handled callback failure has type `PaymentError` and message `x`, and a later callback fails without a type and with the same message, the later failure contributes an empty cause set because `CallbackExternalError` is classified as a wrapper. This union consequently names the execution failure `PaymentError` from the handled callback, while the actual failing operation reports `CallbackExternalError`. Preserve unresolved wrapper candidates when checking ambiguity, and add a regression combining a handled typed callback failure with a subsequent typeless failure.
